description.value: Table: Summon Monster III Creature Subtype(s) Albino Snake* (Reptilian, [holy/shadow]) Dark Hedgehog (Daemon, Evil, Extraplanar) Giant Crab* (Aquatic, [holy/shadow]) Hundlegs* [(holy/shadow)] Imp Devil (Devil, Evil, Extraplanar, Lawful) Poison Bat* (Avian, [holy/shadow]) Raldo* [(holy/shadow)] Shark* (Aquatic, [holy/shadow]) Warg Wolf* [(holy/shadow)] This spell functions like Summon Monster I , except that you can summon one creature from the 3rd-level list with a CR rating of 2 or lower, 1d3 creatures of the same kind from the 2nd-level list , or 1d4+1 creatures of the same kind from the 1st-level list .
